highlight.$description: Specular highlight on glass controls (order 1.26). This style draws no highlight of its own: the glass edge.

lens.$description: The lens of a glass thumb (order 1.26). This style has no lens: its strong material.

on-clear.$description: Text on clear glass (order 1.26). Clear glass is a plain material here, so default text.

backdrop-bright.$description: The brightest picture glass may sit over, for the contrast gate (order 1.26).

backdrop-dark.$description: The darkest picture glass may sit over, for the contrast gate (order 1.26).

body.$description: Surfaces (achromatic base). Lighter is higher in the stack. Source: src/styles/globals.css

overlay-solid.$description: Foreground overlay scale (white on dark, ink on light). Suffix = alpha x 100

scrim-solid.$description: Scrims for shadows and modal backdrops (black in both themes)

subtle.$description: Borders. Decorative hairlines only; a control boundary uses --st-border-control

control.$description: A11y addition. Studio draws input outlines at --overlay-20 (about 1.9:1). SC 1.4.11 needs 3:1 for a boundary that identifies a control.

control-hover.$description: Input border under the pointer (spec 4.3): overlay-60 dark, overlay-70 light.

bright.$description: Text. Five tones are the whole text palette (docs/design.md)

subtle.$description: A11y change. Studio: #787878 dark, #6b7280 light. Both fall under 4.5:1 on the card surfaces they are used on.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls only (exempt from SC 1.4.3). Never for placeholders.

placeholder.$description: A11y change. Studio uses --text-disabled for placeholders, which fails 4.5:1.

link.$description: Links stay achromatic and are always underlined (SC 1.4.1).

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill.

on-accent.$description: Ink on a pastel accent fill.

dim.$description: The grey first line of a two tone heading.

fill.$description: Studio primary is neutral: an overlay fill (FK2 Button variant primary).

fill-hover.$description: A11y change. FK2 hovers at overlay-30; the label measured 4.23:1 over surface-3. 28% white is the closest step that reaches 4.5:1 (4.55:1).

fill-pressed.$description: FK2 returns to the resting fill on press.

border.$description: Carries SC 1.4.11 for the translucent fill.

tint.$description: Soft fill of the primary (emphasis soft). Studio is neutral: an overlay.

on-surface.$description: The primary as text and icon colour on body and surfaces. Studio is neutral: the bright text.

1.$description: Identity accents (categorical). Pastel on dark, deep foreground-safe on light. Each has a 10% tint

fill.$description: Semantic state. Use the *-text tone on a *-10 tint; use *-fg as text on a plain surface

text.$description: A11y addition. Studio sets --danger as text, which is under 4.5:1 on --bg-surface-2 (dark) and white (light).

solid.$description: Solid fill for a button. Dark: a light tone with ink text, like the accents.

on-solid.$description: Text and icons on the solid fill, 4.5:1 or more on solid and solid-hover.

fill.$description: No Studio source: set to sit with info text.

ring.$description: Focus. Studio: 1px --overlay-20 ring (about 1.9:1). Changed to a 2px solid achromatic ring plus halo (SC 2.4.7, 2.4.13 spirit, 1.4.11)

light-idle.$description: At rest the lights are plain light dots (the reference); mac colours on hover of the group.

hover.$description: Light value darkened from #ff2bd6 (2.8:1 on the light canvas).

guide.$description: Light value darkened from #00c8ff (1.9:1 on the light canvas).

placeholder.$description: Base tint of the empty module placeholder: text subtle at 4%.

1.$description: Charts in the admin console (dark only, like the desk). Validated with the dataviz skill's validate_palette.js against the window glass (#151515): - Categorical, fixed order, never cycled: all six in L 0.48 to 0.67, 3:1 or more on the glass, worst adjacent CVD delta E 8.4, normal vision 19.3. "Other" and context series are muted. - Ordinal (funnel steps, light to dark): monotone, adjacent delta L 0.06 or more, the dark end 2.25:1 on the glass (values are labelled in text beside each bar). - Sequential (retention grid, low to high): text on bins 0 to 3 is white (5.4:1 or more), on bins 4 and 5 ink (7.1:1 or more); every cell prints its value.

7.$description: Added for the contract; not yet validated for colour vision deficiency.

8.$description: Added for the contract; not yet validated for colour vision deficiency.

7.$description: Added for the contract: the light end of the ramp.

1.$description: Blue to orange through a grey middle. No Studio source; first pass.

stripe.$description: Stripe colour of the empty module placeholder: text subtle at 6%.

bg.$description: Canvas. The board sits on --bg-surface inside a --bg-body shell; sections are --bg-surface-2 with an --overlay-40 edge (canvas audit, DECISIONS 2026-10-27)

edge.$description: Section frame edge, 3:1 against the board and the section.

dot.$description: Banana addition (Studio canvas is plain). Decorative only.

halo.$description: A11y addition for light theme: neon green on #f6f7f9 is about 1.3:1, so a 1px dark ink halo carries the 3:1.

border.$description: Light value is ink: the white handle and green edge both fail 3:1 on the light canvas.

ring.$description: Notes are board furniture: white ring in Studio. Light value is ink (white fails on a light canvas).

card.$description: Tile cards, context menus, canvas top-start corner, notch.

window.$description: Studio draws a window as a flat panel.

panel.$description: Panel: an inset bottom edge, then a drop shadow.

card.$description: Studio cards are flat tiles: no shadow at rest.

window-strong.$description: Strong blur for small chrome. No Studio source; matches Desk.

window-saturation.$description: Saturation applied with the window blur, a unitless filter amount. Studio is flat: 1.

grain.$description: Film grain over the backdrop. Studio has none.

sans.$description: Fonts. Inter is SIL OFL 1.1. Arabic falls to IBM Plex Sans Arabic (OFL), then Noto Sans Arabic (OFL)

secondary.$description: A11y change. Studio secondary buttons rest at --text-muted on --overlay-10 (4.17:1 dark).

text.$description: Ship = accent-1 (mint, 'saved / status'). Light uses Studio's --success-text-muted (#065f46): accent-1 #047857 is 4.45:1 on the tinted chip.

color.$description: Banana yellow identity mark (logo dot, favicon). The primary button uses --st-primary-* below.

mark.$description: The Bend mark: yellow on dark, ink on light.

halo.$description: For focus over images and canvas items: a halo then the ring, so it reads on any picture.

primary.$description: Focus on a primary fill: an inner ring against the fill, then an outer ring against the surface.

text.$description: A11y change. Studio uses --text-muted (about 3.9:1 on the dark cap face).

thumb.$description: Opaque gray at 3.2:1 on surface 5 and 10:1 on the body (SC 1.4.11). The source was text subtle at 58%, 1.5 to 2.7:1.

thumb-hover.$description: One text step stronger than the thumb, so hover reads without color alone.

default.$description: Resting fill of a filled control.
